meta.title: InkFight v2 technique research: 12 martial-arts styles

conventions.ticks: Fighting-game frames are 60 per second, the same as sim ticks, so SF frame counts are used 1:1. startup = first active tick (Move.from), active ticks run from..to, total = startup + active + recovery - 1 (Move.dur).
conventions.tekken_scaling: Tekken 8 data (wavu) is far slower than the SF-tempo our sim uses (Tekken jab i10, SF6 jab 4f), so Tekken startup/recovery are multiplied by 0.42; active = (tot - recv - startup + 1) * 0.42, at least 2.
conventions.mult: Damage relative to the source game's jab: SF6 dmg / 300, SFV dmg / 30, Tekken dmg / 7, capped at 3. The current MOVES table uses jab = 0.7, so multiply by 0.7 to drop a value into MOVES; STYLE_POWER rescales chains anyway.
conventions.reach_px: SF6 range (1.0 ~ a jab) x 70 px, measured past the shoulder with a body width of 70 px. Long moves whose range includes a step are capped (see frame_data.adjustment); Tekken and SFV moves have no range data, so reach is estimated from a matching SF6 move.
conventions.knock_launch_lunge: Design values on the same scale as src/game/moves.ts (knock 3-14, launch 0-9, lunge 1-10). Not from frame data.
conventions.height: high = head (top 0.95, bot 0.6), mid = body (0.75 / 0.4), low = legs (0.35 / 0); as_move.top/bot use these. Throws use 0.9 / 0.25.
conventions.tip: One of the Move tip values: hand | handB | foot | footB | knee | head. Elbows use hand (the elbow sits next to it at close range).
conventions.keyframes: Each keyframe is {t, pose} with pose = per-bone {abs} or {rel} radians, the src/game/poses.ts format: 0 = forward, -PI/2 = up, PI/2 = down, PI = behind. Limbs use abs, torso/head use rel. Keyframes 1-3 include the FIGHT preset (GUARD + STANCE) under the move-specific bones. pose 'STYLE_STANCE' means return to the style's stance_pose. lunge (px) is the body shift at that frame; flip marks the mid-spin mirror; hop is a small jump.
conventions.existing_move: The current MoveName this technique could reuse (the pose/timing in moves.ts), or null if it needs a new move.

gaps: Savate has no fighting-game representative; all its frame data is borrowed from SF6 characters with similar moves (Ken, Terry, Manon, Juri).
Systema has no exact fighting-game character; SFV Kolin (Russian commando style) and Tekken Dragunov (commando sambo) are used as stand-ins.
Wing Chun frame data comes from Tekken 8 Leroy Smith (scaled), except biu sao (SF6 Chun-Li).
Throw damage (SF6 1200 = 4 jabs) is capped at mult 3; throws need their own grab rules in the sim.
Tekken data has no range or active-frame split for many moves; those reach values are estimates.
supercombo.gg blocks automated fetches (HTTP 403); its frame data was read through the open-source FAT app's JSON export of the same tables, which is cited alongside the supercombo page.

styles.name: Boxing
styles.stance: Orthodox, side-on 45 degrees, feet shoulder-width, weight 50/50 on the balls of the feet; chin tucked, lead fist at eye level, rear fist touching the cheek, elbows over the ribs.

mixed_finisher.idea: The classic 1-2 then a looping overhand over the opponent's lowered guard; the kick button acts as the power-punch button for a style with no kicks.

styles.blurb: Hands only: a snapping jab, a straight cross, short hooks and uppercuts, and body shots that sap the guard.

techniques.name: Jab
techniques.drawing_cue: Lead arm snaps out straight at eye level, rear fist stays glued to the chin.
techniques.fits_chain: punch chain opener; also the J in J-J-K

techniques.name: Cross (rear straight)
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear hip and shoulder turn through, back heel lifts, rear arm fully extended along the jab's line.

techniques.name: Lead hook
techniques.drawing_cue: Lead elbow up at shoulder height, arm bent 90 degrees, whole torso turns the fist sideways.

frame_data.adjustment: Ed's st.HP range (1.55) is a straight; hook reach cut to 62 px

techniques.name: Uppercut
techniques.drawing_cue: Knees dip, fist drops to the hip then drives straight up under the chin, palm facing the boxer.

techniques.name: Liver shot (lead body hook)
techniques.drawing_cue: Level change: knees bend deep, torso tilts, fist digs in at belly height under the opponent's elbow.

techniques.name: Overhand right
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear fist loops up over the shoulder and comes down on a diagonal, head dips off the centre line.

techniques.name: Step-in cross (long right)
techniques.drawing_cue: Big lead-foot step, body almost horizontal, rear arm spears forward.
techniques.fits_chain: gap closer; good as an alternative finisher

frame_data.adjustment: Cobra Punch range 2.45 includes a long forward step; capped to 120 px

styles.name: Taekwondo
styles.stance: Gyeorugi (sparring) stance: side-on, feet a stride apart, weight on the balls of the feet with a constant bounce; hands low near the belt to free the hips for kicking.

mixed_finisher.idea: Front kick to back them up, a straight punch as they step in, then a spinning hook kick to the head.

styles.blurb: Kicks first: roundhouse, side kick, spinning back and hook kicks, and a falling axe kick; punches only to set them up.

techniques.name: Jireugi (straight punch)
techniques.drawing_cue: Short straight punch from the hip-level guard, fist horizontal.

techniques.name: Bandae jireugi (reverse punch)
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear fist punches to the chest as the rear hip turns in.
techniques.fits_chain: punch chain slot 2; links into a kick

techniques.name: Ap chagi (front snap kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Knee lifts to the chest, shin snaps out, ball of the foot strikes, then snaps back.

techniques.name: Dollyo chagi (roundhouse kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Supporting foot pivots, hip turns over, instep whips across at rib height.

techniques.name: Yeop chagi (side kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Body turns fully sideways, knee chambers across the body, heel drives out in a straight line; torso leans away.
techniques.fits_chain: kick chain slot 2 or a long poke

frame_data.adjustment: Juri st.HK range 2.26; capped to 130 px

techniques.name: Dwi chagi (spinning back kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Turns the back to the opponent, looks over the shoulder, rear heel thrusts straight back.

techniques.name: Naeryo chagi (axe kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Straight leg rises above the head, then the heel chops down onto the collarbone.

frame_data.adjustment: second (falling) hit of Ryu's 2-hit Axe Kick; both hits' damage

techniques.name: Dwi huryeo chagi (spinning hook kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Full turn, straight leg sweeps around at head height, heel leads.

styles.name: Muay Thai
styles.stance: Tall, square-ish stance, weight on the rear leg so the lead leg can check kicks or teep; hands high and forward, elbows narrow, chin down.

mixed_finisher.idea: Jab-cross to bring the guard up, then a full roundhouse to the ribs (the textbook 1-2-kick).

styles.blurb: The art of eight limbs: push kicks, shin roundhouses, elbows and knees from the clinch, and the flying knee.

techniques.name: Mat na (jab)
techniques.drawing_cue: Tall upright jab, rear hand stays high by the temple.

techniques.name: Mat trong (cross)
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear straight with the hips square, rear heel turning out.

techniques.name: Thip trong (teep / push kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Lead knee lifts, sole of the foot pushes straight into the belly, body leans back.
techniques.fits_chain: kick opener; pushes the opponent out of range

techniques.name: Te tat (roundhouse kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear leg swings through like a bat, shin (not foot) hits the ribs, rear arm swings down for balance.

techniques.name: Sok ti (downward elbow slash)
techniques.drawing_cue: Elbow raised above the head, then chops diagonally down onto the brow.

frame_data.adjustment: Tiger Heavy Elbow range 1.71 includes a step; capped to 55 px

techniques.name: Sok tat (horizontal elbow)
techniques.drawing_cue: Forearm level with the floor, elbow point swings across the jaw as the torso turns.

techniques.name: Khao trong (straight knee)
techniques.drawing_cue: Hips thrust forward, knee drives straight up into the body, hands pull the opponent's head down.

techniques.name: Khao loi (flying knee)
techniques.drawing_cue: Running jump off the rear leg, knee leads, arms thrown back.

styles.name: Karate
styles.stance: Zenkutsu-dachi / kamae: long front stance, front knee over the toes, back leg straight; lead hand extended at chin height, rear fist chambered at the hip or held by the solar plexus.

mixed_finisher.idea: Front kick lands, reverse punch follows, then a foot sweep drops them (kihon combination).

styles.blurb: Clean straight lines: lead jab, reverse punch, knife hand, front/round/side kicks and a foot sweep.

techniques.name: Kizami-zuki (lead jab)
techniques.drawing_cue: Lead fist shoots out with a small front-foot slide, rear fist at the hip.

techniques.name: Gyaku-zuki (reverse punch)
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear fist twists out from the hip to the solar plexus as the lead fist pulls back (hikite).

techniques.name: Shuto-uchi (knife-hand strike)
techniques.drawing_cue: Open hand cocked by the ear, edge of the palm chops down onto the collarbone.

techniques.name: Empi-uchi (stepping elbow)
techniques.drawing_cue: Long step in, elbow point drives forward into the sternum.

frame_data.adjustment: 2-hit move (elbow then punch); first hit modelled

techniques.name: Mae-geri (front kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Knee up, toes pulled back, ball of the foot snaps into the belly.

techniques.name: Mawashi-geri (roundhouse kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Knee lifts sideways, hip rolls over, instep hits the side of the head.

techniques.name: Yoko-geri kekomi (side thrust kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Hips sideways, heel thrusts out in a straight line, foot edge horizontal.

techniques.name: Ashi-barai (foot sweep)
techniques.drawing_cue: Drops low, sole of the front foot hooks the opponent's ankle out sideways.

styles.name: Street
styles.stance: Square brawler stance: feet parallel, fists low and wide or one hand pawing, chin up; no fixed guard.

mixed_finisher.idea: Paw, swing big, then grab the head and drive a knee: an untrained but effective sequence.

styles.blurb: No rules: pawing jabs, big haymakers, a headbutt, stomp kicks and a bulldog takedown.

techniques.name: Pawing jab
techniques.drawing_cue: Half-open lead hand flicks at the face, almost a shove.

techniques.name: Haymaker
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear arm winds way back, swings in a wide flat arc, whole body follows.

techniques.name: Headbutt
techniques.drawing_cue: Grabs with both hands, neck stiff, forehead snaps into the nose.

frame_data.adjustment: Zangief range 1.6 includes his forward lean; capped to 50 px

techniques.name: Dirty uppercut
techniques.drawing_cue: Short rising punch from the hip at point-blank range.

techniques.name: Shin kick
techniques.drawing_cue: Toe-poke or shin swing at the knee, no chamber.

techniques.name: Front stomp kick
techniques.drawing_cue: Knee high, flat sole shoves into the stomach like kicking a door.

techniques.name: Clinch knee
techniques.drawing_cue: Both hands pull the head down, knee rams up.

frame_data.adjustment: Marisa's Knee includes a step; capped to 60 px

techniques.name: Bulldog takedown (headlock throw)
techniques.drawing_cue: Arm wraps the neck, body turns and drags the opponent face-first to the ground.
techniques.throw_note: Grab: in-game it should only connect at point-blank range and ignore block (or lose to a jab).

styles.name: Systema
styles.stance: No fixed stance: relaxed, upright, knees soft, hands loose in front of the body at waist height, constant small steps and breathing.

mixed_finisher.idea: Stamp the shin to fold the stance, a loose palm to the face, then sweep the planted leg.

styles.blurb: Loose and relaxed: whipping palm and hammer-fist strikes, short elbows, stop kicks, sweeps and takedowns.

techniques.name: Palm strike
techniques.drawing_cue: Loose arm whips out, heel of the palm hits the chin, wrist relaxed.

techniques.name: Hammer-fist
techniques.drawing_cue: Fist rises, bottom of the fist drops onto the head like swinging a hammer.

techniques.name: Short elbow
techniques.drawing_cue: Turn of the shoulders brings the elbow across at close range.

techniques.name: Stop kick (push kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Sole of the foot meets the hip of an advancing opponent and stops them.

techniques.name: Shin stomp
techniques.drawing_cue: Heel drives down and forward onto the shin or knee.

techniques.name: Leg sweep
techniques.drawing_cue: Drops and scythes the planted leg away with the back of the calf.

techniques.name: Snap knee
techniques.drawing_cue: Small step in, knee snaps into the thigh or belly.

techniques.name: Shoulder takedown
techniques.drawing_cue: Steps behind the opponent's leg, shoulder pushes the chest, they trip backwards.
techniques.throw_note: Grab: in-game it should only connect at point-blank range and ignore block (or lose to a jab).

styles.name: Capoeira
styles.stance: Ginga: constant rocking step between two wide crouched positions, rear leg sweeping back, the same-side arm across the face to cover.

mixed_finisher.idea: Push kick to the belly, open-hand slap as they recover, then a rasteira takes the standing leg.

styles.blurb: Brazilian ginga: crescent and spinning kicks, sweeps, handstand kicks and open-hand slaps.

techniques.name: Galopante (open-hand slap)
techniques.drawing_cue: Open palm cups and swings at the ear from out of the ginga.

techniques.name: Cotovelada (elbow)
techniques.drawing_cue: Rising elbow from a low crouch into the chin.

techniques.name: Bênção (push kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Flat sole pushes straight into the chest, body leaning back.

techniques.name: Meia-lua de frente (front crescent kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Straight leg swings up and across the face in an arc, inside to outside.

techniques.name: Martelo (roundhouse kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Instep or lower shin to the temple; hips turn over, arm swings back.

techniques.name: Armada (spinning crescent kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Steps across, turns the back, straight rear leg swings round at head height.

frame_data.adjustment: Round Arch range 0.79 measured from the turned body; set to 100 px

techniques.name: Meia-lua de compasso (spinning heel kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Both hands on the floor, head low, rear leg spins round high with the heel leading.

techniques.name: Rasteira (sweep)
techniques.drawing_cue: Hands on the floor, the extended leg hooks and pulls the standing foot.

styles.name: Wing Chun
styles.stance: Yee jee kim yueng ma: narrow, high stance, knees pinched inward, square to the opponent; lead hand forward on the centre line, rear hand guarding behind it (wu sao).

mixed_finisher.idea: Slap the guard aside, flood the centre line with chain punches, finish with a stamping kick to the knee.

styles.blurb: Centre-line economy: vertical-fist straight punches, chain punching, trapping hands, short elbows and low kicks.

techniques.name: Straight vertical punch
techniques.drawing_cue: Vertical fist travels straight down the centre line, elbow stays down.

techniques.name: Pak sao punch (slap-and-hit)
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear palm slaps the opponent's lead arm down while the other hand strikes.

techniques.name: Lin wan kuen (chain punch)
techniques.drawing_cue: Fists roll over each other in a fast vertical cycle, walking forward.

frame_data.adjustment: 3-hit flurry (3, 3, 20 dmg) collapsed into one active window; mult set to 1.6 for the whole flurry

techniques.name: Biu sao (darting-fingers thrust)
techniques.drawing_cue: Fingers extended together, hand darts at the throat from beneath the opponent's arm.

techniques.name: Pai jarn (horizontal elbow)
techniques.drawing_cue: Elbow swings level across the jaw while stepping in.

techniques.name: Front heel kick
techniques.drawing_cue: Low straight kick with the heel to the hip or belly, foot turned slightly out.

techniques.name: Low side kick (knee stamp)
techniques.drawing_cue: Turns sideways, heel stamps down onto the opponent's knee.

styles.name: Judo
styles.stance: Shizentai (natural posture): upright, feet hip-width, knees soft; both hands forward at chest height reaching for the lapel and sleeve.

mixed_finisher.idea: Strike to provoke a reaction, inner reap to push them back, then a uchi-mata as they step forward (classic renraku-waza).

styles.blurb: Throws, not strikes: foot sweeps, leg reaps, shoulder and hip throws, and a sacrifice circle throw.

techniques.name: Atemi (short strike)
techniques.drawing_cue: Short straight strike from the gripping hand to break posture.

techniques.name: De-ashi-barai (advanced foot sweep)
techniques.drawing_cue: Upright, the sole sweeps the opponent's stepping foot sideways while the hands pull.

techniques.name: O-uchi-gari (major inner reap)
techniques.drawing_cue: Leg hooks inside the opponent's leg and reaps it back, chest drives forward.
techniques.throw_note: Grab: in-game it should only connect at point-blank range and ignore block (or lose to a jab).

techniques.name: O-soto-gari (major outer reap)
techniques.drawing_cue: Steps beside the opponent, reaping leg swings back through the back of their thigh.

frame_data.adjustment: wavu lists no recovery for throws; set to 20 ticks like the SF throws

techniques.throw_note: Grab: in-game it should only connect at point-blank range and ignore block (or lose to a jab).

techniques.name: Seoi-nage (shoulder throw)
techniques.drawing_cue: Turns in under the opponent's arm, back against their chest, bends and pulls them over the shoulder.
techniques.throw_note: Grab: in-game it should only connect at point-blank range and ignore block (or lose to a jab).

techniques.name: Uchi-mata (inner thigh throw)
techniques.drawing_cue: Turns in, the rear leg sweeps high up between the opponent's legs as the body tips forward.
techniques.throw_note: Grab: in-game it should only connect at point-blank range and ignore block (or lose to a jab).

techniques.name: Tomoe-nage (circle throw)
techniques.drawing_cue: Falls onto the back pulling the opponent in, foot in their belly, and rolls them overhead.

frame_data.adjustment: Manon's sliding move is a strike, so the reach is the slide; a true tomoe-nage is close range

techniques.throw_note: Grab: in-game it should only connect at point-blank range and ignore block (or lose to a jab).

styles.name: Kung Fu
styles.stance: Gong bu / ma bu: low bow or horse stance, weight sunk, front hand forward in a palm or claw, rear hand guarding the chest.

mixed_finisher.idea: Straight punch, chopping fist from above to raise the guard, then a low spinning sweep.

styles.blurb: Low stances and animal hands: bow-stance punches, short-power palm, tiger claw, heel and crescent kicks, tornado kick and sweeps.

techniques.name: Chong quan (bow-stance punch)
techniques.drawing_cue: Front leg bends into a bow stance as the fist drives straight out.

techniques.name: Fa jin palm (short-power palm)
techniques.drawing_cue: Barely moves, then the palm explodes into the chest from the whole body.

techniques.name: Tiger claw (fu jow)
techniques.drawing_cue: Both hands with bent clawed fingers strike forward together, low wide stance.

techniques.name: Pi quan (chopping fist)
techniques.drawing_cue: Fist rises over the head and splits down onto the opponent like an axe.

techniques.name: Deng jiao (heel thrust kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Toes pulled back, heel drives straight out into the belly.

techniques.name: Bai lian tui (outside crescent kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Straight leg swings up across the body and out, the hand slaps the foot.

techniques.name: Xuanfeng jiao (tornado kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Jumps and spins in the air, the trailing leg sweeps round at head height.

techniques.name: Sao tang tui (sweeping leg)
techniques.drawing_cue: Drops onto one bent leg, the straight leg spins round along the floor.

styles.name: Kickboxing
styles.stance: Boxing guard on a slightly wider, more square base so either leg can kick; hands high, weight centred.

mixed_finisher.idea: The Dutch-style 1-2-low kick: punches up top, then the shin to the thigh.

styles.blurb: Punches flowing into kicks: jab-cross-hook, low leg kicks, switch kicks, head kicks, spinning back fist and superman punch.

techniques.name: Jab
techniques.drawing_cue: Lead arm straight out, chin behind the shoulder.

techniques.name: Cross
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear straight with full hip turn.

techniques.name: Lead hook
techniques.drawing_cue: Elbow up, arm bent, turns through the jaw.

frame_data.adjustment: Dee Jay's st.HP range up to 1.8; hook reach cut to 64 px

techniques.name: Low leg kick
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear shin chops into the outside of the opponent's thigh, arm swings back.

techniques.name: Switch kick (body)
techniques.drawing_cue: Small hop swaps the feet, then the lead leg kicks the ribs.

techniques.name: High roundhouse (head kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear leg rises high, shin wraps round the head.

techniques.name: Spinning back fist
techniques.drawing_cue: Full turn on the lead foot, the back of the fist whips round into the head.

frame_data.adjustment: Feng's Backfist is thrown from a back-turned stance; +4 ticks startup added for the turn

techniques.name: Superman punch
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear leg kicks back as a feint, body leaps forward and the rear fist punches mid-air.

styles.name: Savate
styles.stance: Upright boxing-style guard, body angled, weight slightly back on the rear leg, lead hand forward and fairly open; light on the toes (kicks thrown with shoes).

mixed_finisher.idea: Jab-cross, then a piston side kick to push them out before they can answer.

styles.blurb: French boxing with shoes: toe-tip whip kicks, piston side kicks, hooking kicks, a shin-scraping low kick and clean boxing.

techniques.name: Direct bras avant (jab)
techniques.drawing_cue: Lead straight, upright posture.

techniques.name: Direct bras arrière (cross)
techniques.drawing_cue: Rear straight from the angled guard.

techniques.name: Crochet (hook)
techniques.drawing_cue: Bent-arm hook with either hand.

frame_data.adjustment: 2-hit move; the total damage is modelled

techniques.name: Coup de pied bas (low sweep kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Inner edge of the shoe scrapes the shin while the body leans back out of range.

techniques.name: Fouetté médian (mid whip kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Roundhouse that lands with the toe of the shoe at the ribs, kicking leg nearly straight.

techniques.name: Fouetté figure (high whip kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Same whip kick to the head, toe pointed.

frame_data.adjustment: Manon st.HK range 2.28; capped to 130 px

techniques.name: Chassé latéral (side piston kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Turns sideways, knee chambers, sole drives straight out like a piston.

frame_data.adjustment: Ken st.HK range 1.92; capped to 125 px

techniques.name: Revers (hooking kick)
techniques.drawing_cue: Leg extends past the head, then the sole hooks back into it.
